caption: GDS import dialog: the new opt-in 'Auto-connect all pins after placement' checkbox (default OFF) below the existing re-route option.
After import with auto-connect ON: both facing pin pairs are routed with the normal direct-first/A*-fallback router — smooth S-bends across the offsets.
A pair the router cannot route (target pin buried in a component body) is KEPT on the canvas as a blocked path AND named in the import report — never silently red.
